description: List workspace-relative paths changed in the working tree, or against an optional git base ref. Use before review_changes when you need the path list alone, or let review_changes auto-discover by omitting paths. Fails when git is unavailable — that is not the same as an empty change set.

base.description: Optional git base ref (e.g. origin/main). Omit for the working tree (staged, unstaged, and untracked).

name: changed_paths
title: Changed paths
